concurrentWork: Repository builds and deterministic validation ran concurrently. Timing is local regression evidence, not isolated throughput qualification.
measurementScope: Thirty-minute fixed-working-set regression: one process, four opaque scopes, 20 fixed keys per scope, 64 offered storm callers per scope; Cache apply/refresh/TTL/invalidation and EventHub publish/subscribe only. Does not measure signed ingress, command routing, live Discord, fleet capacity or durable storage.

memoryObservations.interpretation: Actual process RSS and allocator snapshots are distinct from cache accounting. All owned cache/hub counters return to zero. Runtime pools and bounded checkpoint history may remain above cold start; this is not an allocation trace, a fleet qualification or evidence about unmeasured workloads.

peer: offline fixed-key cache/broadcast scripts; no credentials or sockets
sourceDrift: None in the recorded cache/hub/harness sources or executable between in-run capture and final validation.
sourceHashCapture: Captured while the measurement was running; measured sources were unchanged from the aa4325a base commit and remain subject to final hash comparison.
